title: helipterum corymbosum
intro: Helipterum corymbosum, commonly known as St. Mary's feather, is a flowering plant native to Australia. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of Helipterum corymbosum include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, making it a potential remedy for conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
